method: One SODA query per New York calendar day, created_date between the day's local midnight and its last millisecond, selecting unique_key,created_date,complaint_type,community_board, ordered by unique_key and paged by 50000; a day is complete when its last page holds fewer rows. Requests are deduplicated by unique_key, keeping the latest captured revision (the latest capture, then the later day), and counted by creation day, never by closure. Requests with a missing or unrecognized board or problem, and recognized cells outside the frozen 2024 frame, are counted apart. A cell-day absent from the exhausted enumeration has zero requests; a day with no request in any frame cell is a source gap and stops the domain. The target census covers 2026-06-03 to 2026-08-31 over the frame the panel was selected from; its captures were acquired after 2026-08-31 had ended in New York. Days 2025-09-01 to 2026-06-02 are the frozen selection context, unchanged and not re-requested; identifiers are deduplicated within each census.
